info.about: Project S-11 is a game developed by Paragon 5 and published by Sunsoft for the Game Boy Color.
info.trivia: Developed by Paragon 5, it was released exclusively in North America on January 3, 2001, and never came out in Japan or Europe.
info.why: ModRetro has reissued it for its Chromatic handheld, but collectors still pay more for the 2001 Sunsoft cartridge than for a sealed reissue.
